server.name: Bouncie
server.title: Bouncie
server.description: Connected at every turn. Location, vehicle health, driving data, diagnostics, and more!

tools.name: getUserVehicles
tools.title: Get User Vehicles
tools.description: Get all vehicles associated with the authenticated user, including each vehicle's ID, VIN, nickname, and make/model/year.

tools.name: getVehicleOverview
tools.title: Get Vehicle Overview
tools.description: Get a complete snapshot of a vehicle — current status (driving, parked, idling, or any device issue), last known location, fuel level, battery, odometer, and any active diagnostic trouble codes. Use this for any question about a vehicle's current state, whether broad ("how is my car doing?", "give me a rundown") or specific ("what's my fuel level?", "where is my car?", "is my check engine light on?").

tools.name: getTrip
tools.title: Get Trip
tools.description: Get the details for a specific trip, including start and end addresses and GPS coordinates for the trip route.

tools.name: getLatestTrip
tools.title: Get the Latest Trip
tools.description: Get the current trip in progress or the most recently completed trip for a given vehicle, including start address, end address (if completed), and GPS coordinates for the route.

tools.name: tripTimeline
tools.title: Trip Timeline
tools.description: Get a list of trips for a vehicle with their start and end GPS coordinates and times, showing where and when the vehicle was driving over the given timeframe.

start.description: An ISO datetime string representing the beginning of the timeframe to search from

end.description: An ISO datetime string representing the ending of the timeframe to search to

timeframe.description: Timeframe for the query including a start and end ISO datetime string representing at most one week

tools.name: calculateTripStats
tools.title: Calculate Trip Stats
tools.description: Calculates the min, max, average, and total for several trip metrics over a given timeframe to get a full picture of a vehicle's driving habits and patterns. Metrics include average drive speed, hard acceleration counts, hard braking counts, max speed, total idling time, trip distance, trip time, and fuel effeciency.

start.description: An ISO datetime string representing the beginning of the timeframe to search from

end.description: An ISO datetime string representing the ending of the timeframe to search to

timeframe.description: Timeframe for the query including a start and end ISO datetime string representing at most one week

tools.name: vehicleCareEvents
tools.title: Vehicle Care Events
tools.description: Get maintenance and service records for a vehicle, including completed services, notes, odometer readings at time of service, and upcoming service reminders.
